protocol.phase: Exploratory development; not preregistered or confirmatory
protocol.production_state: Working-tree snapshot, including pre-existing user edits; hashes identify actual execution
protocol.endpoint: Test NMSE at training-validation-selected state; test never selects rates or models
protocol.next_stage: Review development failures and exact-BP feasibility, freeze rates and protocol, then run 20 fresh paired seeds
comparisons: spatial gate vs uniform RMS gate
protocol.controls: All factorial conditions retain the same excitatory context cue; all conductances and readouts learn
caveats: Current injection matches a training-initialization tonic operating point, not every voltage during training
Cue-derived gate under tonic/current forward models is a computational intervention, not a demonstrated local biological mechanism
Uniform-RMS matches delivered-signal RMS, not parameter-gradient norm; matched-state diagnostics separately match core update norm
Common somatic error supplied; all neurons are artificial directed steady-state trees
Independent source/gradient transfer audit establishes Figure 5 code parity, not population generalization by itself

anatomy.endpoint: Signed transport-vs-driving-force changes at fixed soma voltage/error and fixed initial electrical parameters
anatomy.inference: Cell summaries within each mouse; sites and cells are not independent animals

functional.endpoint: Within-minus-between-subtree held-out response covariance, weighted by inhibitory contact abundance
functional.controls: Anatomical sites selected without functional outcomes; split-repeat cross-products; descriptive target-wise adjustment for depth, coverage and excitatory abundance; no independent-pair tests
functional.limitation: Observational responses, not recorded learning errors, task contexts or inhibitory activity

interpretation: Exploratory development only; validation-selected rates; all conditions retained; no confirmatory inference
